title: MOVE_EDGE payload
description: Move an edge to a target line (two points) by solving the planes of the incident faces marked movable (spec §10.4).

edgeId.description: A half-edge id of the edge (either of the twin pair) [A].

movableFaceIds.description: Faces whose support planes may change; every other plane is fixed (spec §5 rule 7, §10.1 rule 3).
